questions.question: Identify a marine alga that is used as food.
Most of the Chlorophyceae have one or more storage bodies called ______ located in the chloroplasts.
Synecology can be defined as which of the following?
questions.option_1: A branch of science that deals with the interrelationship of whole biome.
questions.option_2: A branch of science that deals with the interrelationship of individual species with its environment.
questions.option_3: A branch of science that deals with the interrelationship of two species.
questions.option_4: A branch of ecology that deals with the structure, development and distribution of ecological communities.

Which food requires a longer small intestine to digest food?
Why does one get cramps after sudden physical activity?
questions.option_1: The pepsin enzyme releases chemicals that lead to cramps.
questions.option_3: The build-up of hydrochloric acid in our muscles during sudden activity causes cramps.
questions.option_4: The build-up of lactic acid in our muscles during sudden activity causes cramps.
